fatamorgana.configuration.title: Fata Morgana Configuration
fatamorgana.configuration.enabled.toolti: Generate distant terrain with Fata Morgana instead of the Distant Horizons generator. Also switched in game with a key (F7 by default).
fatamorgana.configuration.threads.toolti: 0 = half of the CPU cores. One LOD tile is split across all threads. Takes effect after a restart.
fatamorgana.configuration.full_resolutio: Compute every LOD column instead of one in four. About 3x slower, sharper distant cliffs.
fatamorgana.configuration.fake_trees.too: Add approximate tree canopies to forests, so they are not bald until real chunks load.
fatamorgana.configuration.real_trees.too: On detailed LODs near the player, replay the game's own tree placement: trees stand where and as they will in the real world.
fatamorgana.message.enabled: on, distant terrain from the terrain noise
fatamorgana.message.disabled: off, the Distant Horizons generator works
fatamorgana.message.clear_unavailable: nothing to clear: distant terrain only regenerates in singleplayer
fatamorgana.message.clear_failed: could not clear distant terrain, see the log
